symbols.name: middle transform
symbols.meaning: The operator on vectors of length $t$ whose $k$-th output is the $(-sk \bmod t)$-th output of the normalized Fourier transform $F_t$.
symbols.quote: The middle transform $\mathcal M_t$ is the operator defined by $(\mathcal M_t u)_k=(F_t u)_{-sk \bmod t}$.

symbols.name: chirp factor
symbols.meaning: The unit complex number $\varsigma_j=\exp(-\pi i s j^2/t)$ attached to each integer $j$.
symbols.quote: For each integer $j$, let $\varsigma_j=\exp(-\pi i s j^2/t)$ be the chirp factor.

relations.quote: The middle transform is the inner step of [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md), which wraps it between two Gaussian maps.
The middle transform is computed through [Bluestein's chirp identity](bluestein-chirp-identity.md), which writes it as this cyclic convolution with phases.
